description: DONE (3bd54a5a3, fact-check audited then re-verified 2026-07-03). Stripped backward-looking ticket-ID provenance narration from six .agent/docs files (addressed-arrow, compiler2-migration, pipeline, quoted-source, semantic-fixpoint, telemetry), rewriting each citation to a standing present-tense fact verified against code. THE AUDIT CAUGHT (and this fix corrected) two INHERITED-FALSE claims that citation-stripping would have laundered into bare present-tense falsehoods: (1) compiler2-migration.md claimed 7 union-receiver fixtures 'all run through fz2' — actually only enum_take_drop_split + range_enumerable run all three paths; enum_map_family runs interp-only (build+run deferred on native ReturnLanes arity mismatch); map_enumerable runs run+build (interp deferred, same); enum_tier0 + enumerable_protocol_dispatch + membership_operator are deferred on ALL three paths. (2) enum_reduce_suspend claimed 'runs through fz2 run/interp/build' — actually deferred on all three (native returned suspend continuations lose settled callable boundaries). Corrected sentences cite tests/fixture_matrix.rs:115-155 (defer_for_path -> ignored trial, Ok(()) without check()) + each fixture header's defer.* markers; coordinator re-verified all 8 fixtures' markers against ground truth before fold. Remaining .agent/docs 'fz-' hits are non-citations (externs.md 'fz-visible' term-of-art; telemetry.md fixture/log-path literals fz-00181, fz-compiler2-quicksort). LESSON: a docs sweep that strips citations MUST fact-verify each surviving claim, not just delete the ticket ID — inherited falsehoods are the trap. Two adjacent pre-existing findings ticketed: fz-go4.32 (telemetry.md root_executable_frontier stale). fact-engine.md confirmed citation-free (untouched, family-8 owns it).
title: Strip backward-looking ticket-ID citations from .agent/docs
